description: This file defines the main React application component for the simple notes frontend. It manages state, handles interactions for creating, deleting, selecting, and updating notes, and renders the main layout including sidebar and note editor.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component for the notes application, handling state and rendering layout.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Creates a new note by dispatching a 'create' action.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes a note after user confirmation by dispatching a 'delete' action.

methods.name: handleSelect
methods.description: Selects a note by dispatching a 'select' action.

methods.name: handleUpdate
methods.description: Updates a note's title/body by dispatching an 'update' action with a patch.
